summary: Gone Kaniksu NF lookout: 75-foot L-6 tower and cabin, built 1935, destroyed 1958 per two sources; no source describes the site today beyond a drive-up label.

facts.design: 75-foot pole L-6 tower with a cabin
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1958 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; Forest Lookouts says removed, with no date

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up

evidence.quote: Known lookout personnel: 1935: Mr. and Mrs. Edward Glen; 1938: Jonas Parshall; 1944: Loretta Bell; 1946: Harry Wonenburg; 1947: Harry Hofstetter; 1949: George Brabb; 1950-1951: Mr. and Mrs. Tom Coble.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say destroyed in 1958; Forest Lookouts says removed, with no date. The record uses destroyed 1958 and reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Destroyed 1958 (two sources) versus removed with no date (Forest Lookouts) is unresolved. The Boundary County Museum holds Bonners Ferry Herald runs that might date the loss; not read. No photos found. The only current description is the drive-up label.
